title: KVCOMM: Online Cross-context KV-cache Communication for Efficient LLM-based Multi-agent Systems
authors: Hancheng Ye; Zhengqi Gao; Mingyuan Ma; Qinsi Wang; Yuzhe Fu; Ming-Yu Chung; Yueqian Lin; Zhijian Liu; Jianyi Zhang; Danyang Zhuo; Yiran Chen
venue_full: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems
research_focus: LLM serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: Multi-agent LLM pipelines repeatedly prefill overlapping contexts when agents exchange messages, causing redundant computation and high TTFT. Direct KV cache reuse fails because agent-specific prefixes place shared content at different positions and induce context-dependent cache-offset variance.
problem_statement.zh: 多 agent LLM pipeline 在 agent 交換訊息時，會對重疊 context 重複執行 prefill，造成冗餘運算並提高 TTFT。由於 agent 專屬 prefix 使共享內容位於不同位置，並引發與 context 相關的 KV cache offset variance，因此無法直接重用 KV cache。

key_innovation.en: KVCOMM is a training-free, prompt-adaptive framework that maintains an online anchor pool of observed context-dependent KV cache offsets. It matches embedding-similar anchors, interpolates their offsets, performs RoPE de-rotation/re-rotation for positional alignment, and adds the estimated Key/Value offsets to the base KV cache before decoding.
key_innovation.zh: KVCOMM 是免訓練且可依 prompt 調適的框架，透過 online anchor pool 保存觀察到的 context-dependent KV cache offset。系統匹配 embedding 相近的 anchor、內插其 offset，並以 RoPE de-rotation/re-rotation 完成位置對齊，再將估計的 Key/Value offset 加至 base KV cache 後執行 decoding。

key_improvements.en: Across RAG, math reasoning, and collaborative coding workloads, KVCOMM achieves over 70% reuse without quality degradation. In a five-agent setting, it provides up to 7.8x speedup over the standard prefill pipeline and reduces TTFT from ~430 ms to ~55 ms.
key_improvements.zh: 在 RAG、數學推理與協作 coding 工作負載下，KVCOMM 達成超過 70% 的重用率且品質無損。在 5-agent 設定中，相較 standard prefill pipeline 最高可加速 7.8x，並將 TTFT 由約 430 ms 降至約 55 ms。

reuse_metric.en: Over 70% agent-level reuse across RAG, math reasoning, and collaborative coding workloads without quality degradation; Reuse Rate is the proportion of agents reusing all KV caches during the complete serving procedure.
reuse_metric.zh: 在 RAG、數學推理與協作 coding 工作負載中，agent-level 重用率超過 70%，且未造成品質下降；Reuse Rate 定義為在完整 serving 流程中重用全部 KV cache 的 agent 比例。

workloads_traces.en: Fully connected 2-5-agent RAG, math reasoning, and collaborative coding workflows on MMLU, GSM8K, and HumanEval.
workloads_traces.zh: 在 MMLU、GSM8K 與 HumanEval 上執行 fully connected 2–5-agent RAG、math reasoning 與 collaborative coding workflows。

key_parameters.en: 1x H100; each agent receives 1,024-token user input, 512-token agent prefix, up to 512-token prior response, and generates at most 512 tokens; three-agent length sweep input/prefix 64/128/256/512/1024 and output 128/256/512/1024; entropy threshold gamma=0.3 (sweep .1/.3/.5/.7/.9); anchor pool V=20 (sweep 5/10/15/20/25); CacheBlend recomputes top 20%. Request rate, tool delay, cache capacity, TTL, HF version, and repeats not stated.
key_parameters.zh: 1x H100；每個 agent 接收 1,024-token user input、512-token agent prefix、最多 512-token prior response，最大生成 512 tokens；three-agent length sweep 的 input/prefix 為 64/128/256/512/1024，output 為 128/256/512/1024；entropy threshold gamma=0.3（sweep .1/.3/.5/.7/.9）；anchor pool V=20（sweep 5/10/15/20/25）；CacheBlend 重算 top 20%。request rate、工具延遲、cache 容量、TTL、HF version 與重複次數未載明。

metrics_defined.en: TTFT is decomposed into reusable-KV computation plus one-token decode; quality is task accuracy/pass@1; KVCOMM reuse is the proportion of agents employing reuse.
metrics_defined.zh: TTFT 分解為 reusable-KV computation 與 one-token decode；品質採 task accuracy/pass@1；KVCOMM reuse 為採用重用之 agent 比例。

headline_vs_realistic.en: Up to 7.82x speedup for the fifth agent; the tested length grid ranges down to 2.24x mean speedup, and aggressive gamma settings trade accuracy for reuse.
headline_vs_realistic.zh: 第五個 agent 的 speedup 最高 7.82x；受測 length grid 的平均 speedup 最低為 2.24x，且較積極的 gamma 設定會以 accuracy 換取 reuse。

key_assumption_dynamic.en: KVCOMM assumes agents share a compatible backbone and that online anchors approximate context-dependent KV offsets; topology changes that introduce incompatible models or unseen context relations invalidate reuse.
key_assumption_dynamic.zh: KVCOMM 假設 agent 共用相容 backbone，且 online anchor 能近似 context-dependent KV offset；若拓撲變動引入不相容 model 或未見的 context relation，重用即失效。
